Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the term of bonds issued for transportation purposes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the term of bonds issued for transportationpurposes; and amending RCW 39.42.020.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 39.42.020 and 1971 ex.s. c 184 s 2 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Bonds, notes, or other evidences of indebtedness shall be issued bythe state finance committee. They may be issued at one time or in aseries from time to time. The maturity date of each series shall bedetermined by the state finance committee, but in no case shall anybonds mature later than thirty years from the date of issue, except inthe case of bonds issued for transportation purposes, which in no caseshall mature later than fifteen years from the date of issue. Allevidences of indebtedness shall be signed in the name of the state bythe governor and the treasurer. The facsimile signature of saidofficials is authorized and said evidences of indebtedness may beissued notwithstanding that any of the officials signing them or whosefacsimile signatures appear on such evidences of indebtedness has p. 1 HB 1989ceased to hold office at the time of issue or at the time of deliveryto the purchaser.
